meaning:
1) age, gray hair, hoary head, old age
1a) gray hair, hoary head
1b) old age

renderings.bsb: you will bring my gray hair
you will bring my gray hair
will have brought the gray hair

renderings.kjv: and let not his hoar head

elsewhere.note: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.
“ ‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.
Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.
Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
He shall be to you a restorer of life and sustain you in your old age; for your daughter-in-law, who loves you, who is better to you than seven sons, has given…
Do therefore according to your wisdom, and don’t let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.
He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.
He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.
